message.text:
Only one background runner starts. s3presign.Runner begins immediately in server/server.go via startBackgroundRunners. It runs once on startup. No other scheduled runners are started.

s3presign.Runner repeats every 12 hours via a time.Ticker. memopayload.Runner exists but is never started; its rebuild logic runs synchronously inside CreateMemo and UpdateMemo handlers. internal/scheduler cron infrastructure is present but unused by the server. Webhook spawns four goroutines in package init(), yet these are not started by Server.Start.

q28.
s3presign — immediate `RunOnce` at startup, then a 12-hour `time.Ticker` (`server/server.go`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`)
unused: `internal/scheduler` (cron job scheduler) is never started by the server
unused: `server/runner/memopayload` `Runner` is never started; only `RebuildMemoPayload` is called inline from create/update memo handlers

`Server.startBackgroundRunners` in `server/server.go` is the only place that launches a background runner. The scheduler package is used in its own tests, not in server startup.
